name: dublin-core
label: Dublin Core Metadata
description: ISO 15836 general-purpose metadata standard — used by libraries, repositories, web resources

table_notes.dc_resource: Core resource record holding all 15 Dublin Core elements; multi-valued fields (title, creator, subject, etc.) are stored as JSONB arrays of language-tagged strings.
table_notes.dc_collection: Named grouping of resources (e.g. a digital archive or thematic set); provides collection-level rights and publisher metadata.
table_notes.dc_collection_member: Many-to-many join between dc_collection and dc_resource; records when each resource was added to the collection.

dc_resource.name: id
dc_resource.description: Internal primary key for the resource record

dc_resource.name: identifier
dc_resource.description: DC:Identifier — unique external URI, DOI, ISBN, or URN that identifies this resource

dc_resource.name: title
dc_resource.description: DC:Title — JSONB array of {value, lang} objects supporting multilingual titles

dc_resource.name: creator
dc_resource.description: DC:Creator — JSONB array of agent names or URIs primarily responsible for creating the resource

dc_resource.name: subject
dc_resource.description: DC:Subject — JSONB array of {value, scheme} objects; scheme may be LCSH, DDC, MeSH, or free text

dc_resource.name: description
dc_resource.description: DC:Description — JSONB array of {value, lang} objects containing abstracts or summaries

dc_resource.name: publisher
dc_resource.description: DC:Publisher — entity responsible for making the resource available (organisation or service name)

dc_resource.name: contributor
dc_resource.description: DC:Contributor — JSONB array of agent names with secondary responsibility (editors, illustrators, etc.)

dc_resource.name: date
dc_resource.description: DC:Date — primary date associated with the resource lifecycle (publication, creation, or modification)

dc_resource.name: dc_type
dc_resource.description: DC:Type — DCMI Type Vocabulary term (e.g. Text, Dataset, Image, Collection, Event)

dc_resource.name: format
dc_resource.description: DC:Format — media type or dimensions; use IANA MIME type string (e.g. application/pdf, image/tiff)

dc_resource.name: source
dc_resource.description: DC:Source — URI or citation of the resource from which this one is derived

dc_resource.name: lang_code
dc_resource.description: DC:Language — primary language of the resource content; RFC 5646 tag (e.g. en, fr, zh-Hant)

dc_resource.name: relation
dc_resource.description: DC:Relation — JSONB array of {type, uri} objects linking related resources (isPartOf, replaces, etc.)

dc_resource.name: coverage
dc_resource.description: DC:Coverage — spatial or temporal extent of the resource (place name, bounding box, or date range)

dc_resource.name: rights
dc_resource.description: DC:Rights — rights statement or license URI governing access and use of the resource

dc_resource.name: created_at
dc_resource.description: Timestamp when this metadata record was first inserted

dc_resource.name: modified_at
dc_resource.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this metadata record; NULL if never modified

dc_collection.name: id
dc_collection.description: Internal primary key for the collection

dc_collection.name: title
dc_collection.description: Human-readable name of the collection (e.g. 'Early Modern Pamphlets 1600-1700')

dc_collection.name: description
dc_collection.description: Narrative description of the collection scope, contents, and provenance

dc_collection.name: license
dc_collection.description: License applying to the collection as a whole; use SPDX identifier or rights URI (e.g. CC-BY-4.0)

dc_collection.name: publisher
dc_collection.description: Organisation or service responsible for publishing or maintaining this collection

dc_collection.name: created_at
dc_collection.description: Timestamp when the collection record was created

dc_collection_member.name: id
dc_collection_member.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the membership row

dc_collection_member.name: collection_id
dc_collection_member.description: References dc_collection.id — the collection this resource belongs to

dc_collection_member.name: resource_id
dc_collection_member.description: References dc_resource.id — the resource being included in the collection

dc_collection_member.name: added_at
dc_collection_member.description: Timestamp when this resource was added to the collection

short_description: ISO 15836 general-purpose metadata standard — used by libraries, repositories, web resources
long_description: Dublin Core (ISO 15836-2) is the foundational metadata standard used by libraries, digital repositories, and the web. The 15 core metadata elements cover the complete resource description lifecycle.
when_to_use: Use for digital libraries, institutional repositories, content management, or any resource catalog requiring discovery metadata. Required for OAI-PMH repository compliance and interoperability with WorldCat.
